text:
The meal looks like two cannelloni with meat sauce and cheese, plus a dark soda (probably cola).

The cannelloni portion is roughly 250 g, and almost all of it was eaten, with only sauce smears left on the plate. I estimate about 235 g eaten. At roughly 150 kcal per 100 g (a ricotta/spinach or meat filling with sauce and cheese), that comes to about 350 kcal.

The glass held about 200 ml of cola. Roughly 15% is left, so about 170 ml was drunk. Cola has about 42 kcal per 100 ml, so that is about 70 kcal.

The total is about 420 kcal. For mass I'm counting food only, about 235 g, though including the drink would give about 405 g. The request is for "grams of food eaten", so I'll use the food figure plus the drink, since the kcal figure includes it: 235 + 170 = 405 g.

{"kcal": 420, "mass_g": 405}
